description_en: Queries the list of Anti-DDoS Pro instances in the Chinese mainland by paging
description_zh: 调用DescribeInstances分页查询中国内地高防实例信息列表
name: DescribeInstances

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the instances that you want to query. Specify the value as a JSON string array. Exact match is supported. Example: ["ddoscoo-cn-XXXX1", "ddoscoo-cn-XXXX2"]. 

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify Ip or Remark
parameters.help_zh:
通过实例Id查询实例信息，传入要查询的实例Id数组（JSON字符串）。支持精确匹配。例如，["ddoscoo-cn-XXXX1", "ddoscoo-cn-XXXX2"]。 

若传入该参数，则无需传入Ip和Remark。
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页号，即从几页开始显示。最小值是1。
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，即每页显示多少条结果。最大值是50。
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the instance that you want to query. Exact match is supported. 

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify InstanceIds or Remark
parameters.help_zh:
通过实例IP查询实例信息，传入要查询的实例IP地址。支持精确匹配查询。 

若传入该参数，则无需传入InstanceIds和Remark
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The remark of the instance that you want to query. Fuzzy match is supported. 

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify InstanceIds or Ip
parameters.help_zh:
通过实例备注查询实例信息，传入要查询的实例的备注信息。支持模糊查询。 

若传入该参数，则无需传入InstanceIds和Ip
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The edition of the mitigation plan. Valid values: 9 (Professional)
parameters.help_zh: 防护套餐版本，取值：9（专业版）
parameters.name: edition

parameters.help_en:
The working status of the instance. Valid values:
1: The instance is forwarding traffic as expected.
0: The instance has stopped forwarding traffic
parameters.help_zh:
实例工作状态，取值：
1：正常转发业务
0：已停止业务转发
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en:
The billing status of the instance. Valid values:

1: Normal.
2: Expired.
3: Released
parameters.help_zh:
实例售卖状态，取值：

1：正常
2：过期
3：释放
parameters.name: status

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the instance tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://.

The tag key (Tag.N.Key) must match the tag value (Tag.N.Value)
fields.help_zh:
实例标签的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，且不能包含 http:// 或者 https:// 。

标签键（Tag.N.Key）与标签值（Tag.N.Value）必须键值匹配
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the instance tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. If you specify this parameter, the value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://.

The tag key (Tag.N.Key) must match the tag value (Tag.N.Value)
fields.help_zh:
实例标签的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，且不能包含 http:// 或者 https:// 。

标签键（Tag.N.Key）与标签值（Tag.N.Value）必须键值匹配
fields.name: value

DebtStatus.description_en: The value is fixed as 0, which indicates a subscription instance
DebtStatus.description_zh: 固定取值：0，表示预付费实例

Edition.description_en: The edition of the mitigation plan. The value is fixed as 9 (Professional)
Edition.description_zh: 防护套餐版本，固定取值：9（专业版）

Enabled.description_en:
The working status of the instance. Valid values:
1: The instance is forwarding traffic as expected.
0: The instance has stopped forwarding traffic
Enabled.description_zh:
实例工作状态，取值：
1：正常转发业务
0：已停止业务转发

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the instance expires. The format is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
ExpireTime.description_zh: 实例到期时间。格式为时间戳，单位：毫秒

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the instance. The value is a timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 实例创建时间。格式为时间戳，单位：毫秒

Remark.description_en: The remark of the instance. Maximum length: 500 bytes
Remark.description_zh: 实例备注信息。最大500字节

Status.description_en:
The billing status of the instance. Valid values:

1: Normal.
2: Expired.
3: Released
Status.description_zh:
实例售卖状态，取值：

1：正常
2：过期
3：释放
